children: Italian energy group Eni said it is working with Venezuelan authorities to help revive the country's energy sector. According to Sina Finance, Eni said in a Saturday statement that it is working with Venezuela and other relevant institutions to support the recovery of the country's energy industry. Eni added that it is not yet appropriate to comment on next steps and will provide more details once they are determined.

title: Eni Says It Will Work With Venezuelan Authorities to Revive Energy Sector
